question: Should this timing-sensitive PR receive a proof override, or must the contributor provide redacted live gateway/plugin-binding cancellation evidence before merge?
rationale: Repository policy treats tests and mocks from external PRs as supplemental only, while the contributor argues the timing window is impractical to reproduce without controlled delays.

options.title: Require live runtime proof
options.body: Ask for redacted gateway or plugin logs showing an in-flight bound reply canceled without fallback delivery, plus verification of the fast-abort acknowledgment path.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the controlled focused test as sufficient for this internal timing invariant.

recommendation.title: Require live runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted gateway or plugin logs showing an in-flight bound reply canceled without fallback delivery, plus verification of the fast-abort acknowledgment path.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the plugin-owned conversation-routing surface and are the strongest available owner for deciding its proof boundary.
